confirmation.rule: When the first-pass deck completeness is within [trigger_min_percent, trigger_max_percent], run extra_passes more independent checker passes and take, per question, the median value of all passes. A null bound is disabled.

proof.rule: A question marked requires_proof cannot be 'found' from the deck alone. The checker must cite at least one claim whose status is proven (annex) or confirmed (web); otherwise the code caps the value at 'partial'. A question citing a claim left as 'to_probe' after review is lowered by one step.

annex_gate.rule: Fixed list, per stage and business model: the base list below is written for SaaS, the model block adjusts it with its documents verb, the deck never does. Every document must be present, readable, and cover at least min_months, or hold at least min_count items, when one is given. A missing or too short document stops the reading and produces the request email, document by document. There is no coverage threshold at series D: the list is the gate. Claims left uncovered after matching are listed in the report, they never stop the reading.

name.en: Monthly P&L by product and by geography over 60 months
name.fr: P&L mensuel par produit et par géographie sur 60 mois

requirement.en: Revenue and cost of revenue by product and by geography, operating expenses by function (sales and marketing, R&D, G&A), net burn and free cash flow, month by month.
requirement.fr: Revenus et coût des ventes par produit et par géographie, charges par fonction (ventes et marketing, R&D, frais généraux), burn net et cash-flow libre, mois par mois.

name.en: Audited annual accounts with the auditor's opinion and the accounting standard, last three fiscal years
name.fr: Comptes annuels audités avec l'opinion de l'auditeur et le référentiel comptable, trois derniers exercices

requirement.en: Balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement and the auditor's report with its opinion and the accounting standard applied (IFRS, US GAAP or the local GAAP), for each of the last three fiscal years.
requirement.fr: Bilan, compte de résultat, tableau des flux de trésorerie et rapport de l'auditeur avec son opinion et le référentiel comptable appliqué (IFRS, US GAAP ou référentiel local), pour chacun des trois derniers exercices.

name.en: Cohorts by segment and by acquisition year over 48 months or more
name.fr: Cohortes par segment et par année d'acquisition sur 48 mois et plus

requirement.en: Revenue and logo retention by acquisition cohort, split by segment and by acquisition year.
requirement.fr: Rétention du revenu et des logos par cohorte d'acquisition, ventilée par segment et par année d'acquisition.

name.en: CRM export with weighted pipeline, owner, and win/loss with competitor
name.fr: Export CRM avec pipeline pondéré, propriétaire, et win/loss avec le concurrent

requirement.en: Every deal with stage, probability, amount, owner, segment, product, geography, first contact and signature dates; lost deals with the reason and the competitor.
requirement.fr: Chaque affaire avec son étape, sa probabilité, son montant, son propriétaire, son segment, son produit, sa géographie, ses dates de premier contact et de signature ; les affaires perdues avec la raison et le concurrent.

name.en: Sales roster with quota attainment over 24 months
name.fr: Effectif commercial avec l'atteinte des quotas sur 24 mois

requirement.en: Each rep with start date, quota, attainment by quarter, and departures.
requirement.fr: Chaque commercial avec sa date d'entrée, son quota, son atteinte par trimestre, et les départs.

name.en: Billing export with list price, net price, discount and contract dates over 36 months
name.fr: Export de facturation avec prix liste, prix net, remise et dates de contrat sur 36 mois

requirement.en: Every contract with its list price, net price and discount month by month, and its start date, end date and term.
requirement.fr: Chaque contrat avec son prix liste, son prix net et sa remise mois par mois, et sa date de début, sa date de fin et sa durée.

name.en: Cap table with the terms of every round, this round's term sheet if signed, and any debt agreement
name.fr: Table de capitalisation avec les termes de chaque tour, le term sheet de ce tour s'il est signé, et tout contrat de dette

requirement.en: Every holder with its share and the option pool; for every round closed the price, the liquidation preference, participation, seniority, ratchets and secondary sales or tender offers; the term sheet of this round when one is signed; every debt agreement with its terms.
requirement.fr: Chaque détenteur avec sa part et le pool d'options ; pour chaque tour clos le prix, la préférence de liquidation, la participation, la séniorité, les ratchets et les cessions secondaires ou offres de rachat ; le term sheet de ce tour lorsqu'il est signé ; chaque contrat de dette avec ses termes.

name.en: Three-year financial model with the cash line of this round and a zero-burn scenario
name.fr: Modèle financier sur 3 ans avec la ligne de trésorerie de ce tour et un scénario à burn zéro

requirement.en: Revenue by product and geography, expenses by function, cash, hires, month by month over 36 months, the breakeven month if planned, the cash line with this round and without a further one, and a scenario with spending frozen at the level the cash on hand allows.
requirement.fr: Revenus par produit et par géographie, charges par fonction, trésorerie, recrutements, mois par mois sur 36 mois, le mois du point mort s'il est prévu, la ligne de trésorerie avec ce tour et sans tour supplémentaire, et un scénario où les dépenses sont gelées au niveau que permet la trésorerie disponible.

name.en: Signed contracts of the top 20 customers

requirement.en: The signed contract of each of the twenty largest customers by ARR.
requirement.fr: Le contrat signé de chacun des vingt premiers clients par ARR.

name.en: Board decks or minutes with budget vs actual, last twelve quarters
name.fr: Supports ou comptes rendus de board avec budget contre réalisé, douze derniers trimestres

requirement.en: The board deck or the minutes of each of the last twelve quarters, with the budget or plan of the quarter next to the actual, and the date each was issued.
requirement.fr: Le support de board ou le compte rendu de chacun des douze derniers trimestres, avec le budget ou le plan du trimestre à côté du réalisé, et la date d'émission de chacun.

name.en: Org chart and headcount history over 48 months
name.fr: Organigramme et historique des effectifs sur 48 mois

requirement.en: Headcount by function month by month, start and end dates, and the executive team with start dates.
requirement.fr: Effectifs par fonction mois par mois, dates d'entrée et de sortie, et l'équipe de direction avec ses dates d'entrée.

name.en: Auditor's management letters, last three fiscal years
name.fr: Lettres de recommandations de l'auditeur, trois derniers exercices

requirement.en: The auditor's letter to management or to the audit committee for each of the last three fiscal years, with every control deficiency, significant deficiency or material weakness reported, or the statement that none was.
requirement.fr: La lettre de l'auditeur à la direction ou au comité d'audit pour chacun des trois derniers exercices, avec chaque faiblesse de contrôle, faiblesse importante ou faiblesse significative signalée, ou la mention qu'il n'y en a aucune.

gaps.rule: A gap between a deck figure and the figure found in an annex or on the web is classified by code. Ratio = |deck - found| / max(|found|, 1). minor: ratio <= minor_max_ratio, noted, no penalty. to_probe: ratio <= probe_max_ratio, becomes a question for the call. blatant: above, or the fact does not exist; goes to the reviewer, then stops the reading if no honest explanation is found. Non-numeric contradictions (a named customer that does not exist, a participating preference or an IPO ratchet in the terms that the deck does not state, an acquisition in the cap table that the deck does not state) are blatant by default.

web.rule: A claim is confirmed or contradicted on the web only with at least min_independent_sources sources on distinct domains, after searching both for and against. Otherwise it is unverifiable, which is a valid state, never 'probably false'. Series D keeps the series C scope (the annual accounts filed at the company registry, Infogreffe, Companies House, Handelsregister or the local registry, compared with the audited accounts; the history of the public pricing page on the Wayback Machine; the trend of public reviews, G2, Capterra, over 24 months; litigation and security incidents made public; the rounds raised by competitors) and adds the press of every previous round for its price, the press and the registry for every acquisition made or announced, tender offers and secondary sales made public, the competitors acquired or listed since the series C, and the last IPO filings of the category (S-1, F-1 or prospectus) for the comparables. An ARR is never checked on the internet.

revenue.proof: monthly P&L by product and geography (60 months), audited accounts (three fiscal years)

customers.proof: top 20 contracts, monthly P&L by customer

retention.proof: cohort table by segment and acquisition year (48 months or more)

nrr.proof: cohort table by segment and acquisition year: net revenue retention over 12 months, per vintage

churn.proof: cohort table, CRM win/loss with the reason per lost customer

acquisition.proof: CRM export with channel, segment, product and geography per deal, sales and marketing spend in the P&L

pipeline.proof: CRM export with stage, probability, amount and segment per deal; financial model for the plan

sales_cycle.proof: CRM export with first contact and signature dates

founder_sales.proof: CRM export with the owner of each signed deal, sales roster for the start dates

gross_margin.proof: audited accounts and monthly P&L by product: revenue and cost of revenue

concentration.proof: top 20 contracts, P&L by customer over 36 months

burn_multiple.proof: monthly P&L: net burn and net new ARR, three twelve-month windows, or the quarter where net burn turned positive

rule_of_40.proof: monthly P&L and audited accounts: revenue growth and free cash flow or operating margin, for each of the last three fiscal years

magic_number.proof: monthly P&L: net new ARR of the quarter and sales and marketing spend of the previous quarter

quota_attainment.proof: sales roster: quota and attainment by rep and by quarter

rep_ramp.proof: sales roster: start date and months to full quota per rep

second_engine.proof: P&L by product and geography, CRM export: ARR, start date and economics of the segment, geography, product or channel opened after the first

breakeven.proof: audited accounts or P&L for a breakeven reached; three-year financial model for the month where free cash flow turns positive, the cumulative cash to get there and the cash line with this round and no further one

audited_figure.proof: audited annual accounts: the figure the deck attributes to them

win_rate.proof: CRM win/loss: deals won and lost against each named competitor, by quarter over 36 months

attrition.proof: org chart and headcount history: departures by function and whether regretted

board.proof: board decks or minutes: members, affiliations, independent seats, committees, meeting dates over twelve quarters

pricing.proof: top 20 contracts and billing export showing the price paid and the contract term

cap_table.proof: cap table with the terms of every round

plan_vs_actual.proof: board decks or minutes for the plan or budget of each quarter, monthly P&L for the actual: ARR, net new ARR, net burn, headcount, over twelve quarters

net_price.proof: billing export: list price and net price per contract, month by month; the public pricing page and its history on the Wayback Machine for the list price

discount_rate.proof: billing export: discount per contract, month by month over 36 months

fcf_margin.proof: monthly P&L and the cash flow statements of the audited accounts: free cash flow over revenue, over 36 months

zero_burn_growth.proof: three-year financial model: the zero-burn scenario, spending frozen at the level the cash on hand allows, and the growth it forecasts

product_share.proof: monthly P&L by product: ARR, new ARR and gross margin of each product after the first, and of each product launched in the last 36 months

geo_share.proof: monthly P&L by geography: ARR, new ARR and gross margin outside the home country

liquidation_preference.proof: cap table with the terms of every round and the term sheet of this round: preference multiple, participation, seniority, ratchets, IPO ratchet

debt_terms.proof: cap table terms and debt agreements: amount, rate, maturity, covenants, warrants, security; company registry for registered charges, press, litigation made public

audit_opinion.proof: audited accounts: the auditor's opinion and the accounting standard for each of the last three fiscal years, unqualified or qualified with the reason; the accounts filed at the company registry

controls_certification.proof: the SOC 2 Type II report or ISO 27001 certificate with its date and scope; the public trust page, the certification body's register, security incidents made public

backlog.proof: billing export with contract start, end and term: the contracted revenue not yet recognised and the share of ARR under contracts of two years or more; top 20 contracts for their term

round_price.proof: cap table with the terms: the price and post-money of every round closed, the term sheet of this round if signed; press of every previous round for its announced valuation

round_purpose.proof: three-year financial model: the cash line with this round and no further one, the breakeven month; board decks for the decision on the round and what it precedes

acquired_company.proof: cap table for the consideration, P&L by product for the ARR of the acquired company at closing and today, org chart for the team retained; press of the acquisition, company registry of the acquired entity

management_letter.proof: auditor's management letters: each control deficiency, significant deficiency or material weakness reported for each of the last three fiscal years, or the statement that none was

close_cycle.proof: board decks or minutes: the date each was issued against the end of its quarter, over the last eight quarters

named_customer.proof: top 20 contracts; customer website, LinkedIn, public review

competitor.proof: competitor websites, public reviews of the category

competitor_funding.proof: press of the rounds raised by competitors since the series C, of the competitors acquired or listed since, company registries, investor portfolio pages

exit_comparable.proof: the last IPO filings of the category (S-1, F-1 or prospectus) with the growth, free cash flow margin, net retention, gross margin and backlog they state at IPO; public filings of listed comparables; press of acquisitions in the category with the acquirer named

key_hire.proof: LinkedIn profile of the hire with that role at the company

exec_team.proof: org chart with the executive team; LinkedIn profile of the executive with that role at the company, and for the CFO the audited accounts, the IPO, the sale or the public-company role previously held

exec_departure.proof: org chart with end dates; LinkedIn profile of the executive showing the departure

headcount.proof: org chart and headcount history, P&L by function; LinkedIn headcount and its trend

job_posts.proof: careers page, LinkedIn job posts, by function and by country

reviews.proof: G2, Capterra or the sector's review site, and the trend of ratings and review counts over 24 months

employee_reviews.proof: Glassdoor or the local equivalent: rating, review count, recent reviews for and against

funding.proof: cap table, press of every previous round with its amount and announced valuation, registry

secondary_or_debt.proof: cap table with the secondary sale, the tender offer or the debt line and its terms; press of tender offers and secondary sales made public

expansion.proof: entities and offices in the financial model, the P&L by geography and the org chart; company registries for announced subsidiaries, job posts by country

market.proof: public data behind the bottom-up figures

plan_vs_actual.rule: The report lays out, by code, every claim of claim_type with a metric and a period: the plan read in the board pack, the actual read in the P&L, and the gap in percent, (actual - plan) / |plan|, computed by code. The last `quarters` periods are shown. Per metric, the average gap, where missed_if is set the number of quarters missed (actual below plan for 'below', above plan for 'above'), and the distribution of the quarters by absolute gap: within each band of bands_percent, and beyond the last one. Empty cells stay empty. Displayed next to D1 and H2, never scored.

preference_stack.rule: The report lays out, by code, every claim of one of claim_types as one row: the round or instrument (the claim's `round` field, else its statement), the figure the deck states, the status set by code and the backing. Grouped by round in claim order. Nothing is summed, nothing is valued: the stack is read as the terms state it. Displayed next to H5, never scored.

ipo_comparables.rule: The report lays out, by code, every claim of claim_type that carries a `comparable` and a `metric`: the comparable named, the metric, the value the filing states at IPO, the status set by code, and next to it the deck's own latest figure for the same metric, taken from the last proven or confirmed claim of the matching type. Facts side by side; no multiple, no valuation, no ranking. Displayed next to H6, never scored.

question.en: Which segments are served, and do the last twenty customers match them?
question.fr: Quels segments sont servis, et les vingt derniers clients y correspondent-ils ?

questions.found_if: A nameable profile (size, role, sector) per segment, and the last twenty signed contracts fit one of them.
questions.note: A customer that fits no segment is a question for the call.

question.en: Why do they buy, and why do they renew, per segment, in their own words?
question.fr: Pourquoi achètent-ils, et pourquoi renouvellent-ils, par segment, dans leurs mots ?

questions.found_if: A purchase quote and a renewal quote per segment, or a documented use case with both.
questions.note: One segment quoted for all = partial.

question.en: What was dropped since the series C?
question.fr: Qu'est-ce qui a été abandonné depuis la série C ?

questions.found_if: A segment, geography, product, channel or acquisition abandoned since the series C round, dated, with what triggered it.
questions.note: Nothing dropped since the series C = partial at best.

question.en: ARR today, and the monthly curve over 60 months?
question.fr: ARR aujourd'hui, et la courbe mensuelle sur 60 mois ?

questions.found_if: An ARR and the monthly points over 60 months, matching the P&L and the audited accounts.
questions.note: A growth percentage without its starting point = absent.

question.en: How many paying customers, and the average contract value by segment?
question.fr: Combien de clients payants, et le contrat moyen par segment ?

questions.found_if: A customer count and an ACV per segment, backed by the contracts or the P&L.

question.en: Year-over-year growth for each of the last four years, with the starting points?
question.fr: Croissance sur un an pour chacune des quatre dernières années, avec les points de départ ?

questions.found_if: Five dated ARR points twelve months apart and the four ratios.
questions.note: Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.

question.en: Do the named customers exist, pay, and use the product?
question.fr: Les clients nommés existent-ils, paient-ils, et utilisent-ils le produit ?

questions.found_if: Confirmed outside the deck: a contract in the annexes, and a website, LinkedIn page or public review.
questions.note: Still the central question. Cannot be found from the deck alone. Absent = red.

question.en: How much of ARR do the top twenty customers make, and how has that share moved over 36 months?
question.fr: Quelle part de l'ARR font les vingt premiers clients, et comment cette part a-t-elle évolué sur 36 mois ?

questions.found_if: A share of ARR for the top twenty today and 36 months ago, confirmed against the contracts or the P&L.
questions.note: A single customer above 20 % of ARR is a question for the call, not a verdict.

question.en: New ARR by channel, segment, product and geography?
question.fr: Nouvel ARR par canal, segment, produit et géographie ?

questions.found_if: Each channel, segment, product and geography with its share of new ARR over twelve months, from the CRM export and the P&L.
questions.note: All from one channel or one product = partial.

question.en: Backlog: contracted revenue not yet recognised, and the share of ARR under multi-year contracts?
question.fr: Carnet de commandes : revenu contractuel non encore reconnu, et part de l'ARR sous contrats pluriannuels ?

questions.found_if: The remaining value of signed contracts not yet recognised (RPO) and the share of ARR under contracts of two years or more, from the start and end dates of the billing export and the top 20 contracts.
questions.note: A backlog without the contract end dates behind it = partial. Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.

question.en: Gross margin, confirmed against the audited accounts?
question.fr: Marge brute, confirmée contre les comptes audités ?

questions.found_if: A gross margin with what is included in cost of revenue, and the same figure in the audited accounts.
questions.note: A margin that excludes hosting, support or implementation = partial.

question.en: CAC payback by channel and by segment, and its trend over 36 months?
question.fr: Délai de récupération du CAC par canal et par segment, et sa tendance sur 36 mois ?

questions.found_if: A payback in months per channel and per segment, with the method, and its curve over 36 months.
questions.note: A single blended figure = partial.

question.en: Burn multiple over three twelve-month windows, or the quarter it stopped applying?
question.fr: Burn multiple sur trois fenêtres de douze mois, ou le trimestre où il a cessé de s'appliquer ?

questions.found_if: Net burn divided by net new ARR for each of the last three twelve-month windows, from the P&L, and the direction of the change; or the quarter where net burn turned positive, after which the multiple no longer applies.
questions.note: Growth that slows faster than burn falls is a red signal of the stage. Benchmark shown next to the figure (Sacks), never in the score.

question.en: Rule of 40, three years in a row?
question.fr: Rule of 40, trois années de suite ?

questions.found_if: Revenue growth plus free cash flow or operating margin for each of the last three fiscal years, from the P&L and the audited accounts.
questions.note: Fewer than three years = partial. Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.

question.en: Sales efficiency: magic number?
question.fr: Efficacité commerciale : magic number ?

questions.found_if: Net new ARR of the quarter over the previous quarter's sales and marketing spend, over the last four quarters.
questions.note: B2B only. Weight 0 in B2C.

question.en: Free cash flow margin over 36 months, and its direction?
question.fr: Marge de cash-flow libre sur 36 mois, et sa direction ?

questions.found_if: Free cash flow over revenue, quarter by quarter over 36 months, from the P&L and the cash flow statements of the audited accounts.
questions.note: A margin without its direction = partial. Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.

question.en: What growth does the model forecast at zero burn?
question.fr: Quelle croissance le modèle prévoit-il à burn zéro ?

questions.found_if: A scenario of the three-year model where spending is frozen at the level the cash on hand allows, with the ARR growth it forecasts year by year.
questions.note: A model without a zero-burn scenario = absent. The scenario is read, never judged.

question.en: Breakeven: reached, with its date in the accounts, or dated in the model within the cash of this round?
question.fr: Point mort : atteint, avec sa date dans les comptes, ou daté dans le modèle avec la trésorerie de ce tour ?

questions.found_if: The period where free cash flow turned positive, in the audited accounts or the P&L, or the month where it does in the three-year model with the cumulative cash to get there and the model's cash line staying above zero to that month with this round and no further one.
questions.note: Neither reached nor dated within the cash of the round = absent. The model is read, never recomputed.

name.fr: Prévisibilité et préparation à la sortie

question.en: Plan against actual over twelve quarters: how many quarters within 5 %, within 10 %, and beyond?
question.fr: Plan contre réalisé sur douze trimestres : combien de trimestres à moins de 5 %, à moins de 10 %, et au-delà ?

questions.found_if: For each of the last twelve quarters, the plan of the board pack and the actual of the P&L for ARR, net new ARR, net burn and headcount, and per metric the number of quarters within 5 %, within 10 % and beyond 10 % of plan.
questions.note: The central proof of the stage: a public market punishes a missed quarter, and the board packs say how often the company misses. More than two quarters beyond 10 % of plan in the last two years is a red signal of the stage. Absent = red. Laid out quarter by quarter in the report, with the distribution.

question.en: Reporting: under which standard are the accounts audited, how many days to close a quarter, and what did the auditor's management letters report?
question.fr: Reporting : sous quel référentiel les comptes sont-ils audités, combien de jours pour clôturer un trimestre, et qu'ont signalé les lettres de recommandations de l'auditeur ?

questions.found_if: The accounting standard of the audited accounts (IFRS, US GAAP or the local GAAP) in the auditor's report, the days between quarter end and the issue of the board pack of that quarter over the last eight quarters, and each control deficiency or material weakness of the last three management letters, or the statement that there was none.
questions.note: A material weakness in a management letter is a red signal of the stage. A close cycle without its dates = partial.

question.en: Second act: what share of net new ARR comes from products launched in the last 36 months, and with what economics next to the first?
question.fr: Second acte : quelle part du nouvel ARR net vient des produits lancés depuis 36 mois, et avec quelle économie à côté du premier ?

questions.found_if: The share of net new ARR over twelve months from the products launched in the last 36 months, with the gross margin and the net revenue retention of each next to those of the first product, from the P&L by product and the cohorts.
questions.note: A second act without its own economics = partial at best. No product launched in 36 months = absent.

question.en: Acquisitions since the series C: ARR at closing against today, and the team retained?
question.fr: Acquisitions depuis la série C : ARR à la signature contre aujourd'hui, et équipe conservée ?

questions.found_if: For each company acquired since the series C, the date, the consideration, the ARR at closing and today from the P&L by product, and the share of its team still in the org chart; or the statement that none was made, matching the cap table and the registry.
questions.note: Acquired ARR that shrank since closing is a red signal of the stage. An acquisition absent from the deck and present in the cap table or the registry is a contradiction.

question.en: What share of ARR comes from outside the home country, and with what economics?
question.fr: Quelle part de l'ARR vient de l'extérieur du pays d'origine, et avec quelle économie ?

questions.found_if: The ARR outside the home country as a share of total ARR, by country or region, with its gross margin and new ARR, from the P&L by geography.
questions.note: A geography without its own economics = partial at best.

question.en: Net revenue retention by segment and by cohort vintage?
question.fr: Rétention nette du revenu (NRR) par segment et par millésime de cohorte ?

questions.found_if: An NRR per segment and per acquisition year over a twelve-month window, with the definition used, recomputable from the cohorts.
questions.note: Older cohorts below younger ones are a red signal of the stage and a question for the call. Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.

question.en: Gross retention and logo churn, with the reasons?
question.fr: Rétention brute et churn logo, avec les raisons ?

questions.found_if: A gross revenue retention and a logo churn figure, and a reason per lost customer.
questions.note: Absent = the deck hides churn. Red.

question.en: Do the cohorts flatten at 48 months, in each segment?
question.fr: Les cohortes s'aplatissent-elles à 48 mois, dans chaque segment ?

questions.found_if: Cohort curves of at least 48 months per segment, with the month where they flatten.
questions.note: A segment whose cohorts do not flatten is a question for the call.

question.en: Expansion: what share of new ARR comes from existing customers, and what triggers it?
question.fr: Expansion : quelle part du nouvel ARR vient des clients existants, et qu'est-ce qui la déclenche ?

questions.found_if: A share of net new ARR from expansion, with the trigger (seats, modules, price, second product).

question.en: Market size computed bottom-up with the ACV by segment, and the share already taken?
question.fr: Taille du marché par le bas avec l'ACV par segment, et la part déjà prise ?

questions.found_if: Possible customers per segment multiplied by the ACV signed in that segment, with visible assumptions, and the current ARR as a share of it.
questions.note: An analyst figure = absent.

question.en: Who are the competitors, and what is the win rate against each?
question.fr: Qui sont les concurrents, et quel est le taux de gain contre chacun ?

questions.found_if: Named competitors, the same names in the CRM win/loss with a win rate against each.
questions.note: Web check: omitted competitors become a contradiction.

question.en: Win rate against each competitor, and its trend over 36 months?
question.fr: Taux de gain contre chaque concurrent, et sa tendance sur 36 mois ?

questions.found_if: Deals won and lost against each named competitor, quarter by quarter over 36 months, from the CRM win/loss.
questions.note: A win rate without its trend = partial.

question.en: Pricing power: net price against list price per contract, and the trend of discounts over 36 months?
question.fr: Pouvoir de prix : prix net contre prix liste par contrat, et la tendance des remises sur 36 mois ?

questions.found_if: The list price and the net price of each contract, and the average discount month by month over 36 months, from the billing export.
questions.note: Discounts that rise are a red signal of the stage.

question.en: Which entrants have raised money since the series C, and which competitors were acquired or listed?
question.fr: Quels entrants ont levé depuis la série C, et quels concurrents ont été rachetés ou introduits en bourse ?

questions.found_if: The competitors that raised a round since the series C, with the amount and the date, the competitors acquired or listed since, with the acquirer or the market, and what the deck says about them.
questions.note: Web check: the press of competitors' rounds, acquisitions and listings. A funded entrant or an acquisition the deck does not name is a contradiction.

question.en: Why now, and why still?
question.fr: Pourquoi maintenant, et pourquoi encore ?

questions.found_if: A recent, named, verifiable change, why the window is still open after the series C, and what a well-funded entrant or an incumbent would need.

question.en: Does the executive team exist, and has the CFO already taken a company through an IPO, a sale or public reporting?
question.fr: Le comité de direction existe-t-il, et le CFO a-t-il déjà mené une entreprise à une introduction en bourse, une cession ou un reporting public ?

questions.found_if: CFO, CRO or VP Sales, CTO or VP Engineering, CPO, and a general counsel or head of legal: each named in the deck and found on LinkedIn with that role at the company, and a CFO who has already held audited accounts and been through an IPO, a sale or a public-company finance role, here or before.
questions.note: An executive on a slide who is not on LinkedIn is a contradiction. Absent = red.

question.en: Which executives left in the last 24 months, and why?
question.fr: Quels dirigeants sont partis dans les 24 derniers mois, et pourquoi ?

questions.found_if: Each departure from the executive team with its date and a reason, matching the org chart and LinkedIn.
questions.note: A departure found on LinkedIn and not in the deck is a contradiction.

question.en: Headcount by function over 48 months, and regretted attrition?
question.fr: Effectifs par fonction sur 48 mois, et attrition regrettée ?

questions.found_if: Headcount per function month by month over 48 months, matching the P&L by function, and the share of departures the company did not want.
questions.note: Headcount that does not match the P&L is a gap to probe.

question.en: The board: members, independents, committees, cadence?
question.fr: Le board : membres, indépendants, comités, cadence ?

questions.found_if: The board members with their affiliation, the independent seats, the audit and compensation committees if any with their members, and the meeting dates of the last twelve quarters.

question.en: Controls: three fiscal years audited without qualification, and SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001?
question.fr: Contrôles : trois exercices audités sans réserve, et SOC 2 Type II ou ISO 27001 ?

questions.found_if: An unqualified auditor's opinion on each of the last three fiscal years, and, for a B2B company, a SOC 2 Type II report or an ISO 27001 certificate with its date and scope.
questions.note: Accounts with a qualified opinion are a red signal of the stage. In B2C the certification is not asked: three unqualified opinions = found.

question.en: Do the open job posts match the hiring plan, by function and by country?
question.fr: Les offres d'emploi ouvertes correspondent-elles au plan de recrutement, par fonction et par pays ?

questions.found_if: Public job posts that correspond to the hiring plan of the round, function by function and country by country.
questions.note: A country in the plan with no post: a question for the call.

question.en: Who owns what?
question.fr: Qui possède quoi ?

questions.found_if: Founders, investors, employees, option pool and what is left to grant, from the cap table.

question.en: How much is asked, and what for, by function, product, geography and acquisition?
question.fr: Combien demandé, à quoi ça sert, par fonction, produit, géographie et acquisition ?

questions.found_if: An amount and a breakdown by function, by product, by geography and, when acquisitions are planned, by acquisition.

question.en: Were the goals of the series C reached?
question.fr: Les objectifs de la série C ont-ils été atteints ?

questions.found_if: The goals the series C round set (ARR, NRR, free cash flow margin, breakeven month), each with what was reached and when, from the board packs and the P&L.
questions.note: The series C deck promised them. Absent = red. Shown next to the plan vs actual table.

question.en: Why this round: what does it precede, and is it the last private one?
question.fr: Pourquoi ce tour : que précède-t-il, et est-ce le dernier tour privé ?

questions.found_if: What the deck says the round leads to (profitability, an IPO window, an acquisition programme, a sale), and the three-year model's cash line staying above zero to that point with this round and no further one, or the explicit statement that another round is planned, with its date.
questions.note: A round whose reason is not in the deck is a red signal of the stage. A model that needs another round when the deck says this is the last is a contradiction. Absent = red.

question.en: At what price, against the last round?
question.fr: À quel prix, par rapport au dernier tour ?

questions.found_if: The pre-money of this round as the deck states it, and the post-money of the series C from the cap table with the terms, side by side.
questions.note: A price at or below the last post-money that the deck does not say is a contradiction. The two figures are laid out, never judged.

question.en: The preference stack: every round with its multiple, participation, seniority and ratchets, secondary sales, and debt with its terms?
question.fr: La pile de préférences : chaque tour avec son multiple, sa participation, sa séniorité et ses ratchets, les cessions secondaires, et la dette avec ses termes ?

questions.found_if: For each round, the amount, the investors, the preference multiple, participation, seniority and any ratchet, including an IPO ratchet in the terms of this round; every secondary sale or tender offer with its amount; every debt line with its terms; from the cap table and the terms.
questions.note: A participating preference, a ratchet or an IPO ratchet absent from the deck and present in the terms is a contradiction. Laid out as a table in the report, never valued.

question.en: Which exit path, in facts only, next to the last IPOs of the category?
question.fr: Quel chemin de sortie, en faits seulement, à côté des dernières introductions en bourse de la catégorie ?

questions.found_if: Named acquirers with a public trace of interest in the category, or the last IPOs of the category with their filings, and the growth, free cash flow margin, net retention, gross margin and backlog those filings state at IPO.
questions.note: Facts only, laid out next to the IPO filings of the category. Never a valuation, never a multiple applied to the company.

question.en: Customers we can call, including one that left, one of a product launched in the last 36 months, one outside the home country, and one of an acquired company?
question.fr: Des clients qu'on peut appeler, dont un qui est parti, un d'un produit lancé depuis 36 mois, un hors du pays d'origine, et un d'une entreprise rachetée ?

questions.found_if: Names and a way to contact them, including at least one lost customer, one customer of a product launched in the last 36 months, one outside the home country, and, when an acquisition was made, one customer of the acquired company.

question.en: Executives, board members, one executive who left, and the audit partner, we can call?
question.fr: Des dirigeants, des membres du board, un dirigeant parti, et l'associé d'audit, qu'on peut appeler ?

questions.found_if: Same, plus the audit partner who signed the last opinion.
questions.note: Asked to prepare the call, not to judge the deck.
